key_insight: RS-MFBO combines sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization to cut expensive simulator calls while preserving strong optimization performance.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical, simulator-agnostic way to optimize costly industrial process flowsheets under limited computation budgets.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to reduce the design space to influential variables.
Fit a fidelity-augmented Gaussian process to link low-cost approximations with high-fidelity simulations.
Drive sampling with cost-aware acquisition plus cooldown/promotion rules across fidelities.
evidence_signal: The framework was evaluated on two industrial simulators—plasmid DNA bioprocessing in SuperPro Designer and green fuel synthesis in Aspen HYSYS—across economic and physical objectives.
watch_item: Performance depends on reliable low-fidelity models and sensitivity estimates; poor surrogate fidelity or weak variable screening could reduce gains.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
